say:0:1111201001:0.text: Ferranc's treasure map leads this way! Let's go!
say:0:1111201001:0.source_cn: 弗兰克的藏宝图已经指明了路线，这边这边！

say:1:1111201002:0.text: We're almost to the Crimson Highlands!
say:1:1111201002:0.source_cn: 我们已经快到深红高原了！

say:0:1111201501:0.text: There are terrabirds up ahead! Can we hitch a ride with them? It'll save us some energy.
say:0:1111201501:0.source_cn: 前面有陆行鸟！能不能让这些家伙载我们一程？可以省些力气。

say:1:1111201502:0.text: Take a good look at the terrabird's eyes, they're getting ready to charge!
say:1:1111201502:0.source_cn: 仔细看看那些陆行鸟的眼神吧，它们要攻过来了！

say:0:1111203001:0.text: Remember that person we met earlier? His terrabird went berserk too!
say:0:1111203001:0.source_cn: 记得我们之前遇到的那个人吗？他的陆行鸟也发狂了！

say:1:1111203002:0.source_cn: 我想，这是一种征兆……不详的征兆。

say:0:1111204501:0.text: *Sigh* Why do we always run into these wild creatures? I really don't want to harm them...
say:0:1111204501:0.source_cn: 唉……为什么总是能遇到失常的动物呢？真不想伤害它们……

say:0:1111205001:0.text: Magister, everyone is tired. There's a campsite just ahead where we can rest.
say:0:1111205001:0.source_cn: 主人，我看大家都有些累了。前面有个营地，去那里歇歇吧。
say:0:1111205001:0.male: Magister, everyone is tired. There's a campsite just ahead where we can rest.
say:0:1111205001:0.female: Magister, everyone is tired. There's a campsite just ahead where we can rest.

say:1:1111205002:0.text: This camp feels... strange. Why am I getting a strong aura from this place?
say:1:1111205002:0.source_cn: 这个营地……奇怪，为什么我有一种强烈的预感……

say:1:1111206001:1.text: I've finally found you at last... Antandra!
say:1:1111206001:1.source_cn: 终于找到你了……安丹德拉！

say:2:1111206002:1.text: Satrana?! What are you doing here?
say:2:1111206002:1.source_cn: 萨忒娜？你怎么会在这里？

say:4:1111206003:1.source_cn: 安丹姐姐，这些是你的朋友吗？

say:5:1111206004:1.text: That's right. This is an acquaintance of mine.

say:6:1111206005:1.text: Acquaintance? Is that what I am to you?!
say:6:1111206005:1.source_cn: 熟人？那是什么名不正言不顺的说辞！

say:7:1111206006:1.text: I've spent half my life trying to find you!
say:7:1111206006:1.source_cn: 你知不知道为了找到你，我差点丢掉了半条命！

say:8:1111206007:1.text: And you call me an acquaintance?!
say:8:1111206007:1.source_cn: 结果你竟然说我是你的……熟人？！

say:11:1111206010:1.text: Sorry, Satrana. The last time we met, you said you didn't want to be friends, so I thought...
say:11:1111206010:1.source_cn: 抱歉，萨忒娜，最后一次见面时你曾说，不希望我们再以朋友...

choice_prompt:12:1111206010.text: Sorry, Satrana. The last time we met, you said you didn't want to be friends, so I thought...
choice_prompt:12:1111206010.source_cn: 抱歉，萨忒娜，最后一次见面时你曾说，不希望我们再以朋友相称。所以，我以为……

say:13:1111206011:1.text: She just didn't understand my meaning!
say:13:1111206011:1.source_cn: 是她没有理解我的用意！
say:13:1111206011:1.male: She just didn't understand my meaning!
say:13:1111206011:1.female: She just didn't understand my meaning!

say:14:1111206012:1.text: Enough... I guess it was wishful thinking on my part.
say:14:1111206012:1.source_cn: 够了……简直是我一厢情愿！

say:16:1111206013:1.text: She's leaving, Antandra... Should I go call her back?

say:18:1111206015:1.text: Are you all friends of Satrana? I'm sorry you had to sit through that.
say:18:1111206015:1.source_cn: 诸位，你们是萨忒娜新结识的伙伴吗？真抱歉让你们看见了这...

say:19:1111206016:1.text: Please allow me to formally introduce myself. My name is Antandra, and this is Koko.
say:19:1111206016:1.source_cn: 请容我做个正式的自我介绍，我是安丹德拉。这孩子，她叫卡卡。

say:21:1111206017:1.text: Judging from your appearance, you must be Soren of the Uru Clan. Tales of your feats at the Warsong Festival have spread far.
say:21:1111206017:1.source_cn: 看这位的模样，你一定是乌尔氏族的索恩。你在战歌节的故事...

say:23:1111206018:1.source_cn: 哇哦，索恩现在也是名人了呢。

say:24:1111206019:1.text: That makes you even more qualified to be our magister's friend.
say:24:1111206019:1.source_cn: 很好，这样一来，你更有资格与我伟大的主人一同行动了。
say:24:1111206019:1.male: That makes you even more qualified to be our magister's friend.
say:24:1111206019:1.female: That makes you even more qualified to be our magister's friend.

say:26:1111206021:1.text: What I want to know is why there are so many bounty hunters in this camp.
say:26:1111206021:1.source_cn: 我想知道这里是怎么回事？营地里为什么还有一大群赏金猎人？

say:27:1111206022:1.text: That's quite a long story. These young ones have lost their families, and so I've built this place as a haven for them.
say:27:1111206022:1.source_cn: 说来话长。这些孩子们失去了家人，这个地方算是我为他们搭...

say:28:1111206023:1.text: As for the bounty hunters, I've employed them to assist in protecting the young ones.
say:28:1111206023:1.source_cn: 至于这些赏金猎人，他们受我所雇，和我一起保护着这些孩子们。

say:29:1111206024:1.source_cn: 对他们来说，这倒是个好差事。

say:31:1111206026:1.text: Ah, seems the little ones are acting up again. Excuse me while I deal with this.
say:31:1111206026:1.source_cn: 糟糕，小孩子们又在捣乱了。失陪，我先去处理一下！

say:1:1111207001:2.text: Wow! Your tail is so fluffy! I wish I had a tail like yours!
say:1:1111207001:2.source_cn: 哇……姐姐，你的尾巴真蓬松啊，我也想要你这样蓬松的尾巴！

say:3:1111207002:2.text: Stop pulling on it! It's not something you can take off and wear!
say:3:1111207002:2.source_cn: 别揪了！我的尾巴不可能切下来装在你身上！

say:4:1111207003:2.text: Where are you from? I've never seen you before. How old are you? Can I play with that thing in your hand?
say:4:1111207003:2.source_cn: 姐姐，你是哪来的？从来没见过你呢。你多大了？你手里的东...

say:8:1111207005:4.text: What are you all doing? Stop it right now!
say:8:1111207005:4.source_cn: 你们在干什么？都给我住手！

say:9:1111207006:1.text: I can't take it anymore! Look at this crazy place... bounty hunters, grubby little children... I'm leaving!
say:9:1111207006:1.source_cn: 受不了了！看看这个奇怪的地方……一群孩子，还有一群赏金...

say:11:1111207008:1.text: And you! Antandra, you have to leave with me!
say:11:1111207008:1.source_cn: 至于你！安丹德拉，你必须和我一起走！

say:12:1111207009:1.text: What? Just calm down for a moment...

say:13:1111207010:1.text: I am calm! I traveled all this way just to get you out of the desert!
say:13:1111207010:1.source_cn: 我很冷静！实话告诉你吧，我千辛万苦来找你，就是为了带你...

say:15:1111207011:1.text: You want to take Antandra away from us? No! You can't!

say:16:1111207012:1.text: I saw the future! I saw everything...
say:16:1111207012:1.source_cn: 因为我看到了——我预见了未来！

say:17:1111207013:1.text: If she stays here, only death awaits her!
say:17:1111207013:1.source_cn: 如果她留在这里，等待她的只有死亡！

choice_prompt:18:1111207013.text: If she stays here, only death awaits her!
choice_prompt:18:1111207013.source_cn: 如果她留在这里，等待她的只有死亡！

say:19:1111207014:1.text: Revealing the future is not something I take lightly.
say:19:1111207014:1.source_cn: 不轻易泄露命运，这是我的准则。

say:21:1111207017:1.text: I wish I was. Unfortunately, my prophecies never lie.
say:21:1111207017:1.source_cn: 我也希望自己是在骗你。很可惜……我的预言，从不撒谎。

say:22:1111207018:1.text: No! Don't leave us, Antandra! You can't go!
say:22:1111207018:1.source_cn: 不……安丹姐你别走！你别离开我们！

say:23:1111207019:1.text: It's alright, Koko. I'm not going anywhere.

say:24:1111207020:1.text: How could I possibly leave, Satrana? Who would protect them?
say:24:1111207020:1.source_cn: 我现在不可能离开……萨忒娜。我走了，谁来保护这些孩子？

say:25:1111207021:1.text: You're always protecting other people! As long as I've known you, you've never thought about yourself!
say:25:1111207021:1.source_cn: 你总是在保护别人！每一次我见到你，你都在保护别人！丝毫...

say:26:1111207022:1.text: Who's going to protect you when the time comes?
say:26:1111207022:1.source_cn: 你保护了别人，谁又能保护你？

say:28:1111207024:1.text: Are you listening to what I'm saying? No one has ever been able to alter my prophecies, let alone some child!
say:28:1111207024:1.source_cn: 你一个小屁孩，少在那自不量力！从来没有人能打破我的预言...

say:29:1111207025:1.text: I don't believe you! You're just trying to take away Antandra! I hate you!
say:29:1111207025:1.source_cn: 我不信！你抢走安丹姐姐……是坏人！

say:31:1111207015:1.text: Because I didn't want to believe it...
say:31:1111207015:1.source_cn: 因为我也不愿意相信这则预言……

choice:18:1:2.text: Why didn't you say this sooner?
choice:18:1:2.male: Why didn't you say this sooner?
choice:18:1:2.female: Why didn't you say this sooner?

say:0:1111208101:0.text: Koko, are you feeling better now?
say:0:1111208101:0.source_cn: 卡卡，你冷静些了吗？我们需要好好聊聊。

say:1:1111209001:2.text: I'm not here to bully children! I just want to take Antandra away. That's all I'm trying to do!
say:1:1111209001:2.source_cn: 我可不想欺负小孩！总之，我一定要带安丹德拉离开，这是我...

say:3:1111209002:1.text: Satrana, these children need me. You should understand that.
say:3:1111209002:1.source_cn: 萨忒娜，这些孩子非常需要我，你能理解才对。

say:4:1111209003:2.text: I needed you too, back then! You had no problem abandoning me! I guess they're just more important to you...
say:4:1111209003:2.source_cn: 我也很需要你！可当年你还不是抛下我一走了之？你太偏心了！

say:5:1111209004:1.text: Back then, I had no choice...

say:6:1111209005:1.text: I knew you could take care of yourself. You're kind, smart, and brave. See, you survived and thrived.
say:6:1111209005:1.source_cn: 我知道你会照顾好自己。你是个聪明又勇敢的好孩子，一直都是。

say:7:1111209006:2.text: Don't think I'll forgive you just because you flatter me! Your disregard for your own safety! Why do you always have to be like this?!
say:7:1111209006:2.source_cn: 别以为说了这些好听的我就会原谅你！你不顾自身安危的样子...

say:8:1111209007:1.text: I do care about my well-being, but I can't let the children come to any harm.
say:8:1111209007:1.source_cn: 我在乎自己的安全，但我不能看着孩子们受伤。

say:10:1111209008:1.text: Not only are there bandits running amok, but beasts from the Crimson Highlands have been going berserk.
say:10:1111209008:1.source_cn: 这里不仅有匪徒窥伺，还有许多发了疯的动物们从深红高原那...

say:12:1111209009:1.text: Crimson Highlands? Something is indeed very wrong.
say:12:1111209009:1.source_cn: 深红高原？嗯……果然有问题。

say:15:1111209011:1.text: So... the rumors say the treasure in the Crimson Highlands is actually the source of the desert's unrest.
say:15:1111209011:1.source_cn: 什么……深红高原的宝藏传闻，竟然是让沙漠产生动荡的根源。

say:16:1111209013:1.text: There are still many doubts, but we're traveling to the Crimson Highlands to find the truth.
say:16:1111209013:1.source_cn: 目前还有很多疑点，为了调查真相，我们正在向深红高原前进。

say:17:1111209014:1.text: This hamster is so cute and smart. What a lovely creature!
say:17:1111209014:1.source_cn: 仓鼠这么可爱，还这么聪明，好厉害啊。

say:18:1111209015:1.text: In light of your compliments, I shall ignore you calling me a hamster instead of my name.
say:18:1111209015:1.source_cn: 看、看在你夸我的份上，就不计较你喊我仓鼠了……

say:20:1111209016:0.text: Satrana, since you wish for me to leave, why don't I accompany you to the Crimson Highlands?
say:20:1111209016:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜，我在想，既然你要带我离开，我能不能和你们一起去...

say:21:1111209017:0.text: Wouldn't that be dangerous? I had no intention of traveling to the Crimson Highlands. My aim was to take you away from this dangerous place.
say:21:1111209017:0.source_cn: 那不是更危险吗？我没打算继续向深红高原前进，我想带你离...

say:22:1111209018:0.text: Don't you want me to leave with you? If we can find the root of the desert's unrest and make this place safer for the little ones, I can go in peace.
say:22:1111209018:0.source_cn: 你不是想带我走吗？如果能解决动荡的根源，给孩子们真正安...

say:23:1111209019:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what are your thoughts? I don't know what to think...
say:23:1111209019:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what are your thoughts? I don't know what to think...
say:23:1111209019:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what are your thoughts? I don't know what to think...

choice_prompt:24:1111209019.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what are your thoughts? I don't know what to think...
choice_prompt:24:1111209019.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你怎么看？我现在没有头绪了……
choice_prompt:24:1111209019.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what are your thoughts? I don't know what to think...
choice_prompt:24:1111209019.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what are your thoughts? I don't know what to think...

say:25:1111209020:1.text: Thank you for having me along. I will be anything but a burden.
say:25:1111209020:1.source_cn: 感谢你的接纳，请你相信我会派上用场。
say:25:1111209020:1.male: Thank you for having me along. I will be anything but a burden.
say:25:1111209020:1.female: Thank you for having me along. I will be anything but a burden.

say:26:1111209022:3.text: If you're leaving, I'm coming with you!
say:26:1111209022:3.source_cn: 如果你要离开，那我也一起去！

say:27:1111209023:0.text: Koko, your people need you. You must stay and protect them.
say:27:1111209023:0.source_cn: 卡卡，你的族人们需要你。你应该留在这里保护他们。

say:28:1111209024:1.text: You're lying! You're just afraid I'll get hurt out there!
say:28:1111209024:1.source_cn: 说谎！你是怕我遇到危险才说谎！

say:30:1111209026:1.text: Koko, you have to behave. I can't let you come with me this time.
say:30:1111209026:1.source_cn: 卡卡，不要任性。这一次无论你说什么，我都不会同意。

say:32:1111209028:1.text: I hate you! Antandra is mean!

say:35:1111209029:0.text: Good thing she left... We should get going too.
say:35:1111209029:0.source_cn: 终于走了……我们也出发吧。

say:36:1111209030:0.text: Sorry, everyone... can you wait for a moment? This place is dangerous. Koko may do something crazy and get herself in trouble.
say:36:1111209030:0.source_cn: 抱歉……能请大家稍等吗？周围如此危险，我怕卡卡这孩子冲...

say:37:1111209031:1.text: I need to find her and make it clear that it's not my wish to abandon her.
say:37:1111209031:1.source_cn: 我想找到她，和她说明白，我并不是想要抛下他们。

say:39:1111209021:1.text: Before I was exiled from my own clan, I was and still am a capable warrior. Rest assured, I won't slow you down.
say:39:1111209021:1.source_cn: 被自己的部落驱逐前，我好歹也是一名战士，请放心，我不会...

say:40:1111209012:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate... this is the first I've heard of this.
say:40:1111209012:1.source_cn: 黑金商会啊……我第一次听说，他们有什么阴谋呢……

say:0:1111210001:0.text: I know Koko's favorite places to go when she's upset. I need to check there first.
say:0:1111210001:0.source_cn: 我知道卡卡喜欢的几个地方，我去找找看。

say:1:1111210002:0.text: Let's lend a hand and start searching as well!
say:1:1111210002:0.source_cn: 为了早些出发，我们也来帮忙找人吧。

say:0:1111211001:0.text: Koko isn't here. Let's look somewhere else.
say:0:1111211001:0.source_cn: 卡卡好像不在这里，再去别处找找吧。

say:0:1111212001:0.text: Koko...! Koko...! She isn't here either! Let's keep searching.
say:0:1111212001:0.source_cn: 卡卡——卡卡——！\n好像不在这，换个地方找找看吧。

say:0:1111213001:0.text: Not here either. Why are we doing this again?
say:0:1111213001:0.source_cn: 不在这里。\n还有……我们为什么要帮忙找人？

say:1:1111213002:0.text: We always do this. Stop complaining!
say:1:1111213002:0.source_cn: 这不是家常便饭吗？别抱怨啦……

say:4:1111214002:1.text: No, you didn't either, did you?
say:4:1111214002:1.source_cn: 没有，你那边也没找到吗？

say:5:1111214003:1.source_cn: 是啊……到底跑到哪里去了。

say:6:1111214004:1.text: When children throw tantrums, they sometimes just want to hide and be by themselves.
say:6:1111214004:1.source_cn: 小孩子闹脾气，肯定是躲起来了呗。

say:7:1111214005:1.text: Antandra, since Koko is familiar with this area, we shouldn't be too worried, right?
say:7:1111214005:1.source_cn: 安丹小姐，既然卡卡她对当地很熟悉，应该不需要特别担心吧？

say:8:1111214006:1.text: To be honest, she's probably perched somewhere, watching us as we speak. We won't find her at this rate.
say:8:1111214006:1.source_cn: 嗯……她可能正躲在暗处偷偷观察我们，这样下去是找不到的。

say:9:1111214007:1.text: A child's anger comes and goes like a desert storm.
say:9:1111214007:1.source_cn: 小孩子的怒火来去匆匆，就像这沙漠的天气。

say:10:1111214008:1.text: When she gets hungry, then she'll show herself.
say:10:1111214008:1.source_cn: 等她饿到肚子咕咕叫的时候，自然就会出来了。

say:11:1111214009:1.text: I took a quick look at her fortune. Prosperity and abundance are her future. She'll be fine.
say:11:1111214009:1.source_cn: 看那孩子的模样，我就知道她是个幸运的家伙，不会有事的。

say:13:1111214011:1.source_cn: 抱歉，因为我耽误了大家的行程。

say:14:1111214012:1.text: I'll head back to the camp and leave a message, then we can depart.
say:14:1111214012:1.source_cn: 我回营地给孩子们留个口信，之后我们马上出发。

say:1:1111215001:1.text: Listen now, if you see Koko, remember to tell her that I'll be gone for a while.
say:1:1111215001:1.source_cn: 小狸亚，如果你看到卡卡回来，记得告诉她我走了。

say:2:1111215002:0.text: But... will we ever see you again?
say:2:1111215002:0.source_cn: 那，我们以后还能见到你吗……

say:3:1111215003:1.text: We will meet again, and I promise your life will be better then.
say:3:1111215003:1.source_cn: 在你们的生活回归平静之前，我们还会再见的。

say:4:1111215004:1.text: Remember to mind your elders while I'm gone. They will protect you.
say:4:1111215004:1.source_cn: 我走后，还有这些叔叔继续保护你们。

say:7:1111215006:1.text: Perhaps others of their kind aren't considered so, but these ones are different. Honor binds them. They will hold true.
say:7:1111215006:1.source_cn: 或许其他的赏金猎人不算可靠，但他们不一样。他们很注重名声。

say:8:1111215007:1.text: A while back, I found them lost in a sandstorm and saved their lives.
say:8:1111215007:1.source_cn: 此前，这些人在沙暴中迷失了方位，差点因为饥渴失去性命，...

say:9:1111215008:1.text: In return, they vowed to defend the young ones.
say:9:1111215008:1.source_cn: 算是为了还我的救命之恩，他们答应保护这些孩子。

say:12:1111215010:0.text: I'll remember to tell Koko. Please be careful, Antandra... we don't want you to get hurt.
say:12:1111215010:0.source_cn: 安丹姐姐，我会转告卡卡的。你要小心啊……我们都不希望安...

say:13:1111215011:1.text: I promise I'll be careful. We'll meet again before you know it.

say:0:1111216001:0.text: Now, everyone, let's set off for the Crimson Highlands.
say:0:1111216001:0.source_cn: 各位，出发吧——向着深红高原。

say:3:1111218001:1.text: There's no one else around. Why is this all piled up here?
say:3:1111218001:1.source_cn: 周围一个人也没有，这些东西为什么堆在这里？

say:4:1111218002:1.text: It's alright. I'll just burn up these unruly plants.
say:4:1111218002:1.source_cn: 不要紧，让我来烧掉这些乱七八糟的植物。

say:5:1111218003:1.text: Wait! I want to take a closer look.

say:6:1111218004:1.text: Hmm... I was right. There are seeds of several rare plants mixed throughout. They can be used for divination.
say:6:1111218004:1.source_cn: 嗯……我没看错，这里面居然夹杂着几种珍稀植物的种子，我...

say:7:1111218005:1.text: Wait a moment while I collect them to sift through later.
say:7:1111218005:1.source_cn: 稍等，我把他们都带走，之后再慢慢筛捡。

say:8:1111218006:1.text: You're taking all that with you? Can't you leave some behind?
say:8:1111218006:1.source_cn: 这么多你都要带走？放得下吗？

say:9:1111218007:1.text: It does seem like a lot...

say:10:1111218008:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you good at organizing things? Can you help me?
say:10:1111218008:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you good at organizing things? Can you help me?
say:10:1111218008:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you good at organizing things? Can you help me?

choice_prompt:11:1111218008.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you good at organizing things? Can you help me?
choice_prompt:11:1111218008.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你是不是很擅长收纳来着……可以帮帮忙吗？
choice_prompt:11:1111218008.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you good at organizing things? Can you help me?
choice_prompt:11:1111218008.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you good at organizing things? Can you help me?

say:14:1111218010:1.text: Apologies for the inconvenience, but it would be a dreadful waste to leave this behind. I really appreciate this!
say:14:1111218010:1.source_cn: 对不起嘛……但是我实在不想错过这么好的材料，你就帮帮我...
say:14:1111218010:1.male: Apologies for the inconvenience, but it would be a dreadful waste to leave this behind. I really appreciate this!
say:14:1111218010:1.female: Apologies for the inconvenience, but it would be a dreadful waste to leave this behind. I really appreciate this!

say:0:1111219001:0.text: Perfect, it all fits! Let's move on.
say:0:1111219001:0.source_cn: 完美，全都装进去了！我们继续前进吧。

say:0:1111220001:0.text: Look, a flock of terrabirds wandering just ahead!
say:0:1111220001:0.source_cn: 看，前面有一群陆行鸟幼崽在游荡！

say:1:1111220002:0.text: They've wandered from their nest. If we don't help them, they'll fall prey to predators!
say:1:1111220002:0.source_cn: 是从窝里跑出来的吧？不把他们送回窝里，很快就被野兽吃掉了！

say:0:1111221001:0.text: Their nest was trampled. It seems like someone drove them away on purpose.
say:0:1111221001:0.source_cn: 巢穴有被踩踏的痕迹，似乎有谁将幼崽从这里驱赶了出来。

say:1:1111221002:0.text: Could thieves be after their eggs?

say:0:1111222001:0.text: There's so much junk piled up here. Do we have to move each piece one by one?
say:0:1111222001:0.source_cn: 这么多杂物都堆在这里了？我们要一件件搬开吗？

say:1:1111222002:0.text: Save your strength. Why not let the ironjaw next to you lend a hand?
say:1:1111222002:0.source_cn: 省点力气吧，不如让边上那只钢颚兽来帮帮忙。

say:0:1111223001:0.text: If that ironjaw hits Chippy, Chippy will be launched all the way back to Holistone.
say:0:1111223001:0.source_cn: 钢颚兽要是撞到了我，我大概能直接飞回圣石镇吧。

say:1:1111223002:0.source_cn: 也可能是飞到了薄暮丛林。

say:0:1111224001:0.text: That pile of junk shouldn't even be here.
say:0:1111224001:0.source_cn: 刚才那堆杂物不该出现的。

say:1:1111224002:0.text: Is someone deliberately trying to stop us?
say:1:1111224002:0.source_cn: 就像有人故意阻止我们前进。

say:0:1111225001:0.text: Koko! What are you doing here?

say:1:1111227001:1.text: So that big mess along the way was your doing!
say:1:1111227001:1.source_cn: 原来路上那些乱七八糟的乱子都是你在捣鬼！

say:2:1111227002:1.text: Because I didn't want Antandra to leave! It's your fault for taking her away!
say:2:1111227002:1.source_cn: 因为卡卡不希望安丹姐姐离开！都怪你要抢走安丹姐姐！

say:3:1111227003:1.source_cn: 我可没有抢你的安丹姐姐！

say:4:1111227004:1.text: This desert is in a dangerous state! Antandra's life is at risk!
say:4:1111227004:1.source_cn: 如今的沙漠凶流暗涌，安丹的命数里又藏有生死之灾！

say:5:1111227005:1.text: Don't you care about her safety?
say:5:1111227005:1.source_cn: 要是不与我们同行的话，你不怕死神抢走你的安丹姐姐？

say:6:1111227006:1.text: Do you really think you can protect Antandra yourself?
say:6:1111227006:1.source_cn: 难道，你认为自己能保护安丹德拉！

say:7:1111227007:1.text: I might not be able to protect her, but I want to try!
say:7:1111227007:1.source_cn: 卡卡不一定能保护安丹姐姐，但是……卡卡想要保护安丹姐姐！

say:8:1111227008:1.text: I'm a big girl now! I can fight!
say:8:1111227008:1.source_cn: 卡卡是大孩子，可以战斗！也不怕战斗！

say:9:1111227009:1.text: No one believes me... No one listens to me!
say:9:1111227009:1.source_cn: 可是你们不相信卡卡……不愿意给卡卡一个机会！

say:12:1111227011:1.text: I'm touched by your words and your courage.
say:12:1111227011:1.source_cn: 能听到你说这些话，我觉得自己是个被神明关爱的人。

say:14:1111227013:1.text: If you're this determined, I'm not going to stop you anymore.
say:14:1111227013:1.source_cn: 如果你已经做好了战斗的觉悟，我也不阻止你了。

say:15:1111227014:1.text: The desert recognizes those with true fighting spirit. A Mauler's strength will never be denied.
say:15:1111227014:1.source_cn: 沙漠不会辜负任何一缕斗志，蛮血的勇敢必将得到认可。

say:17:1111227015:1.text: I'll admit she's tough. At least she had the strength to move that boulder...
say:17:1111227015:1.source_cn: 我看她有点能耐，起码能搬动那么大的石头。

say:19:1111227016:1.text: I assume the beast next to Koko did the heavy lifting.
say:19:1111227016:1.source_cn: 唔，石头应该是卡卡身边那只熊搬的吧？

say:20:1111227017:1.text: Still, being able to control such a wild beast at such a young age is impressive.
say:20:1111227017:1.source_cn: 不过，小小年纪能够驱使猛兽，也算值得认可。

say:21:1111227018:1.text: Plus, Koko is familiar with the Crimson Highlands. She could make an excellent guide.
say:21:1111227018:1.source_cn: 而且卡卡对深红高原的地形比较熟悉，可以给我们当向导。

say:23:1111227019:1.text: Magister, do you think it's okay for Koko to join us?
say:23:1111227019:1.source_cn: 主人，你同意卡卡加入吗？
say:23:1111227019:1.male: Magister, do you think it's okay for Koko to join us?
say:23:1111227019:1.female: Magister, do you think it's okay for Koko to join us?

choice_prompt:24:1111227019.text: Magister, do you think it's okay for Koko to join us?
choice_prompt:24:1111227019.source_cn: 主人，你同意卡卡加入吗？
choice_prompt:24:1111227019.male: Magister, do you think it's okay for Koko to join us?
choice_prompt:24:1111227019.female: Magister, do you think it's okay for Koko to join us?

say:25:1111227020:3.text: Hmph... I'm going to be blunt. I'm not good at babysitting. I won't be the one responsible for her.
say:25:1111227020:3.source_cn: 哼……丑话说在前头，我不擅长照顾小孩。

say:26:1111227023:1.text: That settles it. The Magister approves. Welcome to the team, Koko!
say:26:1111227023:1.source_cn: 主人同意了！卡卡，恭喜你，你现在是我们的伙伴啦。
say:26:1111227023:1.male: That settles it. The Magister approves. Welcome to the team, Koko!
say:26:1111227023:1.female: That settles it. The Magister approves. Welcome to the team, Koko!

say:29:1111227025:1.text: I promise you that when you grow up, you'll be proud to have joined us! Because our magister is THE Merlin. Just remember one thing...
say:29:1111227025:1.source_cn: 当你长大，一定会为这段旅途感到骄傲！因为我的主人可是梅...
say:29:1111227025:1.male: I promise you that when you grow up, you'll be proud to have joined us! Because our magister is THE Merlin. Just remember one thing...
say:29:1111227025:1.female: I promise you that when you grow up, you'll be proud to have joined us! Because our magister is THE Merlin. Just remember one thing...

say:30:1111227026:1.text: He's the greatest mage in the world!
say:30:1111227026:1.source_cn: 我的主人，是世界上最伟大的魔法师！
say:30:1111227026:1.male: He's the greatest mage in the world!
say:30:1111227026:1.female: She's the greatest mage in the world!

say:32:1111227021:1.text: Give me a chance! I'll try really hard!
say:32:1111227021:1.source_cn: 不要拒绝我……我一定会努力的！
say:32:1111227021:1.male: Give me a chance! I'll try really hard!
say:32:1111227021:1.female: Give me a chance! I'll try really hard!

say:33:1111227022:1.text: Yes, I'll make a great guide! You won't be sorry!
say:33:1111227022:1.source_cn: 真的吗？太好啦！我会努力当一个好向导！
say:33:1111227022:1.male: Yes, I'll make a great guide! You won't be sorry!
say:33:1111227022:1.female: Yes, I'll make a great guide! You won't be sorry!

choice:24:2:3.text: I think she should join us.
choice:24:2:3.male: I think she should join us.
choice:24:2:3.female: I think she should join us.

say:0:1111228001:0.text: Magister Merlin... I've heard him. Satrana, you've fallen into extraordinary company.
say:0:1111228001:0.source_cn: 梅林……这名号我有所耳闻。萨忒娜，原来你的朋友竟这般伟大。
say:0:1111228001:0.male: Magister Merlin... I've heard him. Satrana, you've fallen into extraordinary company.
say:0:1111228001:0.female: Magister Merlin... I've heard her. Satrana, you've fallen into extraordinary company.

say:1:1111228002:0.text: Yes, even I sometimes feel like it's a dream.
say:1:1111228002:0.source_cn: 是啊，连我都时常感到很不真实呢。
